correctness.rationale: The proof recovers every finite-poset nucleus from its point witnesses, verifies singleton-bottom compositions explicitly, and proves equality iff no comparability edge crosses the defining subset. Componentwise identity/top behavior establishes universal commutation. Edge cases include the empty poset; the complete finite checker independently exhausts all 573 labelled posets on up to four points and all of their nucleus compositions.

value.rationale: The exact all-finite-poset classification is a natural invariant for order-independent composition of closure modalities on finite intuitionistic Kripke frames. It extracts the comparability component decomposition in linear graph time instead of enumerating all 2^n nuclei and finds universally commuting maps by only n single-input tests. It also recovers the comparability graph from singleton commutation, a structural result not arbitrary finite slicing.
